Lily drinks tea every morning. We often go to the zoo together. Lily's favorite subject is math. What's more, take an umbrella; the sky looks grey.
The dance studio is my favorite place. I like my life very much. The dance studio is not far from my home. His main interest is old trains.
My friend Jack is very kind. Jack likes noodles too. Lily and Jack are in the same class.
